emergency_unlock.description_for_keyholder: Let your wearers buy emergency keys or use a safeword to unlock themselves in case of emergency.
emergency_unlock.description_for_wearer: You can buy emergency keys or use a safeword to unlock yourself in case of emergency.
emergency_unlock.choose_method_description_for_keyholder: Choose the unlock methods you want to offer your wearer. When the session starts, your wearer will be able to choose one of the activated methods.
emergency_unlock.choose_method_description_for_wearer: Choose the unlock method you want to use in case of emergency.
emergency_unlock.emergency_key_item_description_for_keyho: Your wearer can buy emergency keys to unlock themself in case of emergency.
emergency_unlock.emergency_key_item_description_for_weare: Use emergency keys to unlock yourself in case of emergency.
emergency_unlock.emergency_keys_description_for_keyholder: In case of emergency, your wearer can buy keys to end their session and get their combination immediately.
emergency_unlock.emergency_keys_description_for_wearer: In case of emergency, you can buy keys to end your session and get your combination immediately.
emergency_unlock.safeword_description_for_keyholder: Configure a safeword that your wearer can use at any time to end their session and get their combination immediately.
emergency_unlock.safeword_description_for_wearer: Configure a safeword that you can use at any time to end your session and get your combination immediately.
emergency_unlock.emergency_key_configuration_description: Configure the number of keys required for unlocking.
emergency_unlock.let_wearer_choose_number_of_keys: Let your wearer choose the number of keys when the session starts
emergency_unlock.let_wearer_choose_number_of_keys_descrip: Recommended if your lock is public.
emergency_unlock.select_number_of_keys: Select the number of required keys
emergency_unlock.select_number_of_keys_description: You can choose this option if you know your wearer.
emergency_unlock.number_of_keys_required_to_unlock: Number of keys required to unlock
emergency_unlock.total_emergency_keys_required_to_unlock: Total emergency keys required to unlock: {{number_of_keys}} ({{price}})
emergency_unlock.safeword_configuration_description: Configure a safeword that you can use at any time to end your session and get your combination immediately.
emergency_unlock.let_wearer_choose_safeword: Let the wearer choose the safeword when the session starts
emergency_unlock.let_wearer_choose_safeword_description: Recommended if your lock is public.
emergency_unlock.enter_the_safeword_description: The safeword will be displayed to the wearer when the session starts.
emergency_unlock.disclaimer_alert_for_keyholder: Emergency unlock is not a substitute for your wearer's own emergency unlock method. Your wearer is responsible for their safety in case of an emergency.
emergency_unlock.disclaimer_alert_for_wearer: Emergency unlock is not a substitute for your own emergency unlock method. You are responsible for your safety in case of an emergency.
emergency_unlock.learn_how_to_secure_your_keys: Learn how to secure your keys.

parental_controls.description_for_keyholder: Control the wearers devices. The wearer shall provide their parental control accounts to this extension once they entered the lock.
parental_controls.description_for_wearer: Let the owner of this lock control your devices. You can register your parental control account to this extension once the lock is started. You can add multiple accounts (e.g. a free account for each of your devices). The Parental Control App supports Windows, Android, iOS and macOS. There is no excuse to not to add all your devices!
parental_controls.account_freezing_description_for_wearer: Allow the owner to freeze your Parental Control account(s). When frozen, the email and password for your Parental Control account are temporary changed and you will temporary lose control over your account. Your accounts are unfrozen when the lock is opened or deserted. Not recommended for paid Parental Control account subscriptions.
parental_controls.account_freezing_description_for_keyhold: Allow you to freeze the wearers Parental Control account(s). When frozen, the wearer will temporary lose control over their account until the lock is opened or deserted.
parental_controls.account_freezing_warning: This is a dangerous setting. It case of technical problems or outages of chaster, your Parental Control account may get lost. Chaster can not help to recover them. Use with care.

accountList.title: Linked Accounts
accountList.summary: This list displays all accounts that are linked to this lock and the devices they control.
accountList.no_accounts_for_keyholder: There are no linked accounts yet. Push your wearer to add their parental control accounts on the Extension page.
accountList.no_accounts_for_wearer: There are no linked accounts yet. Set up your devices in the parental control app and then link these accounts here.

filterContent.title: Category Filtering
filterContent.description: Select a web category below to set filtering rules.

filterDomains.title: Domain Filtering
filterDomains.description: Set filtering rules for specific websites. These rules override the category rules. Note that chaster.app can not be blocked.

blockApps.title: Games & Apps
blockApps.description: Allow or block your lockee's apps.

linkAccount.title: Link new Account
linkAccount.summary: Provide the credentials for accounts that shall be managed by this lock. You link as many free or premium accounts as you like. The provided credentials will only be stored for the duration of the session.
linkAccount.freezeWarning: This lock may prevent you from accessing your linked Parental Control accounts until the lock is opened or deserted.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description_for_wearer: Choose what capabilities the owner of this lock shall have over your devices
capabilities.description_for_keyholder: Choose what capabilities you want to have over the wearers devices
capabilities.FILTER_CONTENT_description_for_wearer: The owner can block websites and content categories on your devices
capabilities.FILTER_CONTENT_description_for_keyholder: You can block websites and content categories on the wearers devices
capabilities.BLOCK_APPS_description_for_wearer: The owner can block, or set time limits for apps on your devices
capabilities.BLOCK_APPS_description_for_keyholder: You can block, or set time limits for apps on the wearers devices
capabilities.TRACK_ACTIVITY_description_for_wearer: Allow the owner to track activities on your devices (app usage, web searches and browser history)
capabilities.TRACK_ACTIVITY_description_for_keyholder: Allow the owner to track activities on the wearers devices (app usage, web searches and search history)
capabilities.TRACK_LOCATION_description_for_wearer: Allow the owner to track the geo-location of your devices
capabilities.TRACK_LOCATION_description_for_keyholder: Allow you to track the geo-location of the wearers devices
capabilities.LOCK_DEVICES_description_for_wearer: ⚠ Allow the owner to set up device time limits and lock down your devices
capabilities.LOCK_DEVICES_description_for_keyholder: ⚠ Allow you to set up device time limits and lock down the wearers devices
capabilities.LOCK_DEVICES_warning: This is a dangerous setting. Choose only if there is a sufficient level of trust between keyholder and wearer

parental_controls.hide_changes_description_for_wearer: Changes to device rules made by the keyholder will be hidden in the lock history
parental_controls.hide_changes_description_for_keyholder: Changes to device rules made by you will be hidden in the lock history
